item.title: Daily Minute — October 21, 2026
item.description: What you do COMES FROM what you think. You cannot separate yourself from the truth by “giving” autonomy to behavior. item.title: Lesson 117: For morning and evening review:
item.description: For morning and evening review: [103] “God, being Love, is also happiness.” Let me remember love is happiness And nothing else brings joy.And so I choose To entertain no substitutes for love. [104] “I seek but what belongs to me in truth.” Love is my heritage, and with it joy. These are the gifts my Father gave to me. I would accept all that is mine in truth. On
